title: IKEA
thesis: This episode argues that IKEA is a unique, globally-scaled furniture company with no direct competitors in its specific market segment. It suggests that IKEA has reached a stage of 'escape velocity' where it is impossible to compete directly with them on price or quality, and that its core optimization function is to provide maximum value to as many people as possible.
